command.description: Request command such as REQUEST or BIND.

flag.description: One source RPC interface flag per attribute.

interface-uuid.description: UUID identifying the RPC interface or service.

interface-version.description: Interface version reported for this DCE/RPC interaction.

operation-number.description: RPC operation number identifying the invoked method within its interface.

response-command.description: Response command such as RESPONSE, BINDACK, or FAULT.

description: An observed DCE/RPC operation and its interface identity, including operation number, commands and bind acknowledgement information. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/dce_rpc, https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/rpc_interface.
name: dce-rpc
